newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms vs dollar and stg.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms vs dollar and stg.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against both dollar and sterling on Tuesday, reflecting international market trends and central bank intervention, foreign exchange dealers said.

The rupee was fixed at a commercial mean rate of 20.7415 to the dollar from 20.7845 on Monday and at 33.941 to the sterling from 34.011. Forex dealers said the rupee's fixing was done in line with the weakening of the dollar on overnight international markets, mainly against yen.
They added that the central bank sold dollars in the interbank forex market on Monday mid afternoon slightly below the prevailing interbank rate.
